justification: Although some applicants have Article 11 complaints listed in the appendix, the judgment's merits reasoning is conducted entirely under Article 5 § 1 (unlawful detention), with Article 11 findings disposed of only by a brief cross-reference to well-established case-law in paragraph 12 without any standalone Article 11 merits analysis, and the operative provisions do not identify a specific Article 11 violation separately from the omnibus 'other complaints' holding.
